title: Depth=10 (bracketing 8 vs 12)
description: Changed DEPTH from 8 to 10, leaving ASPECT_RATIO/HEAD_DIM and all other hyperparameters untouched, to fill the gap between baseline (8) and a1's proposed 12.
reflection: val_bpb improved from 1.014027 to 1.002530, a solid win from a one-line change. This confirms the depth-8 default was undertrained for a 5-min budget and the optimum is deeper. Combined with a1's DEPTH=12 and a2's DEPTH=6 results, the group should get a clear read on the shape of the depth/width curve for this time budget -- if 12 beats 10, push further (14+); if 10 beats 12, the optimum is nearby 10.
